app.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Level-5. Use your own copies of the game.

mods.title: Patch sources
mods.sub: Same as mobile Enma Patcher: GitHub repos or local ZIPs. Order matters, the last mod wins on conflict.
mods.empty: No mods. Add the translation repo or a local ZIP to get started.
mods.badRepo: The repository must look like user/repo.
mods.repoFmtSub: The layout must mirror the package internals (assets/…, data/…, res/…). An optional enmapatcher.cfg.json at the root may define appName.

android.title: Android
android.sub: Patch the .apks with your own .drmb and export an .apk ready to install or sideload.
android.pkgHint: Best is the full .apks exported with SAI or Swift Backup: base + splits + asset pack.
android.checkTitle: Single APK: it must be checked
android.checkBody: If it is already patched you can continue. If it is clean, buy the game and export the full .apks before patching.
android.force: Continue anyway at my own risk
android.drmbHintReq: Required for .apks: provides the bypass (base/smali) and the asset pack (split/).
android.drmbHintOpt: Optional if you start from an already patched APK.
android.smaliNote: Includes a license bypass: it will be rebuilt with apktool (get it under Tools).
android.appNameHint: Empty to use the mod's appName.
android.noModsHint: No mods enabled: only the DRMB bypass (if any) will be applied.
android.noModsBody: No mods are enabled. The patch will only apply the license bypass from your .drmb, if present. Continue?
android.smaliBody: The enabled mods include {n} smali file(s). Smali is executable Dalvik code and can do anything an app can do, including stealing data. Only continue if you trust the mod author.
android.needDrmb: Your .drmb is missing: select it to continue.
android.signV1: v1 signature: won't install on Android 11+.
android.uninstallHint: Uninstall the original game first: the signature differs and Android refuses to update.

ios.title: iOS
ios.sub: Patch a decrypted .ipa and export it for sideloading, or install it with your account the iLoader way.
ios.ipaHint: It must contain Payload/*.app. Non-decrypted App Store .ipas will not work.
ios.howHint: Mod files are matched by exact path, relative to the .app, or with a Payload prefix. Missing files are added inside the .app. Then sign with your account (Account tab) or export for Sideloadly, AltStore or Scarlet.
ios.noModsHint: No mods enabled: the IPA will only be cleaned and re-packed.
ios.noModsBody: No mods are enabled. The IPA will only be cleaned of old signatures and re-packed. Continue?
ios.appNameHint: Empty to use the mod's appName.
ios.needMods: Enable at least one mod in the Mods tab.
ios.stripped: Original signature stripped ({n} entries): SideStore will sign from scratch.
ios.accountHint: Pick it when exporting/installing: use this one in SideStore, Sideloadly or AltStore.

account.title: Account
account.sub: iLoader-style install: your Apple ID signs the IPA with a free development certificate (revoked every 7 days) and installs it on the connected device.
account.idHint: Your Apple email. It never leaves this machine: only local signing tools use it.
account.passHint: Do not use your normal password. Create one at appleid.apple.com → App-Specific Passwords. You can revoke it anytime.
account.labelHint: A name to tell your accounts apart.
account.empty: No accounts yet. Add your first Apple ID.
account.signSub: Import the .p12 certificate and .mobileprovision profile for this account (export them once from Sideloadly/AltStore). The app signs the IPA on this PC so installers do less work on the phone.
account.p12PassHint: Used only when importing the identity. Leave empty if the .p12 has none.
account.noIpa: No patched IPA in this session yet. One will show up here after an iOS patch completes.
account.needIpa: Patch an .ipa in the iOS tab first.

tools.title: Tools
tools.sub: External dependencies the patcher uses when needed. Only apktool is required if your .drmb includes smali/.
tools.noDevices: adb answers but no authorized devices. Enable USB debugging.
tools.noAdb: No adb. Download Google platform-tools and drop the folder under Tools, or add adb to the PATH.
tools.hint_apktool: Only needed if the patch includes smali/ (license bypass). Downloads itself.
tools.hint_uber: v1+v2 signing of the resulting APK. Without it, jarsigner (v1) is used.
tools.hint_zsign: IPA signing for iOS sideloading. Downloads itself (official v1.1.2). Optional if you export for Sideloadly/Scarlet.
tools.hint_adb: Direct install on Android. Put platform-tools under Tools or on the PATH.
tools.hint_java: Needed for apktool and signing. Already detected on this machine.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: App language, appearance and behavior. Everything is stored on this machine.
settings.langSub: Languages come from the locales folder. Drop a new code.json there to add one without touching code.
settings.accentSub: Tints the preset primary color (loaders, focus rings, badges).
settings.fontSub: The preset one or the system one.
settings.introSub: The Enma Patcher logo animation on startup.
settings.introEachLaunch: Show the intro on every launch
settings.logoSub: Custom sidebar logo. The OS icon is baked in at build time.
settings.dataSub: Locally stored settings and Apple account.
settings.dataHint: Stored in settings.json inside the app data; you can edit it by hand.

tour.s1b: Your .apks plus your .drmb become a signed .apk ready to install.
tour.s2b: Your decrypted .ipa gets patched and signed with your account, iLoader-style.
tour.s3b: GitHub repos or local ZIPs. Order matters: the last one wins.
tour.s4b: Save your Apple ID with an app-specific password to sign and install on your iPhone.
tour.s5b: Language, theme, colors, data and debug. Everything lives in files you can edit.

discord.madeBy: This tool is made by Project Make a Dream

crash.title: Crash log
crash.sub: Automatic capture of app errors. Copy, save or send it.
crash.endpointHint: Placeholder for now: put your endpoint here.

sign.title: APK signing
sign.sub: Tell it your Android version and it uses what's needed. On Android 11+ v1 no longer installs.

errors.drmbRequired: For an .apks you need your own .drmb (bypass + asset pack). Select it to continue.
errors.singleApk: You passed a single .apk. Use “Check” to verify whether it is already patched; if it is clean, buy the game and export the full .apks (base + splits) before patching.
errors.apktoolMissing: The patch includes smali/ but tools/apktool.jar is missing. Download it from Tools.

update.availableShort: Update available: {v}. Restart to install from the banner.
update.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
